svg.aria-label: Backend & real-time features. Architecture: Controller, service and middleware layers in C++, Qt and Drogon. Backend features: Syslog, admin access, a backup service and API-based AI review. Database performance: Batched SQL queries and PostgreSQL notification listeners. Live dashboards: Real-time dashboard updates over WebSocket connections. WebSocket: Live dashboard updates C++ services built with Qt and Drogon.
